# Prompt Vault

> Prompt Vault is a Japanese image-generation prompt vault built around reusable prompt blocks and gallery-first templates.

Prompt Vault is a Japanese prompt library for image generation.

## What this site is for

- Search prompt blocks by title, purpose, or block ID
- Open image-first templates from the gallery
- Copy full prompts from the modal with one click
- Recombine blocks for VTuber, social posts, reaction images, character sheets, banners, and comics

- [Home](https://prompt-vault-cg3.pages.dev/)

- [Pages verification](https://github.com/KAFKA2306/prompt-vault/blob/main/scripts/verify_pages.sh)

## Local use

- Run `python3 app.py` for local preview
- Run `python3 build.py` to regenerate `dist/`
